items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Now you did part of the score for a Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis movie

ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean your whole life flashes before your eyes.
[laughs] Now you did part of the score for a Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis movie called, “You’re Never Too Young.”
Oh, I’d just do production numbers, those kind of things, the big dance numbers, ‘cause I’d learned how to do that stuff when I was doing the Show of Shows.
